name: MegaNeRF
definition: A framework for training large-scale 3D scenes that support interactive human-in-the-loop fly-throughs, addressing challenges of modeling thousands of images with varying lighting, large model capacities, and fast rendering.
summary: MegaNeRF is a framework for training large-scale 3D scenes by decomposing them into spatial cells with parallel-trained NeRF submodules, enabling scalable data parallelism unlike methods relying on pre-trained networks.
